Class TypedJsonSchemaObject.StringJsonSchemaObject

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.schema.UntypedJsonSchemaObject
org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.schema.TypedJsonSchemaObject
org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.schema.TypedJsonSchemaObject.StringJsonSchemaObject
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonSchemaObject
Enclosing class:
TypedJsonSchemaObject
public static class TypedJsonSchemaObject.StringJsonSchemaObject extends TypedJsonSchemaObject
针对 `type : 'string'` 模式元素的 `JsonSchemaObject` 接口实现。
通过流式 API 提供对模式具体细节（如 minLength、maxLength、pattern 等）的程序化访问，生成不可变的模式对象。
Since:
2.1
Author:
克里斯托夫·施特罗布

    toDocument()
    ```json { "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", "title": "Document", "type": "object", "properties": { "id": { "type": "string", "description": "Unique identifier for the document" }, "title": { "type": "string", "description": "Title of the document" }, "content": { "type": "array", "items": { "$ref": "#/definitions/Block" }, "description": "Array of content blocks" }, "metadata": { "type": "object", "properties": { "author": { "type": "string" }, "created_at": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" }, "updated_at": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" } } } }, "required": ["id", "content"], "definitions": { "Block": { "oneOf": [ { "$ref": "#/definitions/Paragraph" }, { "$ref": "#/definitions/Image" }, { "$ref": "#/definitions/Heading" } ] }, "Paragraph": { "type": "object", "properties": { "type": { "type": "string", "enum": ["paragraph"], "const": "paragraph" }, "text": { "type": "string" } }, "required": ["type", "text"] }, "Image": { "type": "object", "properties": { "type": { "type": "string", "enum": ["image"], "const": "image" }, "src": { "type": "string", "format": "uri" }, "alt": { "type": "string" } }, "required": ["type", "src"] }, "Heading": { "type": "object", "properties": { "type": { "type": "string", "enum": ["heading"], "const": "heading" }, "level": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 6 }, "text": { "type": "string" } }, "required": ["type", "level", "text"] } } } ```
